THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Munasingha Kariyawasam Appuhamilage Don SomadasaGunawardana, Minister of Lands hereby declare under Sub-section(1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands describedbelow are needed for Ihala Kolaeliya wewa, Pallama and will beacquired under the provisions of that Act.

Six (06) allotments of land depicted as Lots ‘C’, ‘D’, ‘E’, ‘J’, ‘H’,‘G’ of the land Surveyed by the Superintendent of Surveys, Puttalamin Tracing No. PU/PLL/2013/213 of the Village of Potthukkulama,No. 664, Nandimithrapura Grama Niladhari Division in KumaraPallampatthu, of the Divisional Secretariat, Pallama of PuttalamDistrict, in North Western Province:
01. Lot ‘C’ – Extent: 0.0038 HectareNorth: Road; East: Lot No. 4 of F.V.P. 240 A; South: Lot H; West:Lots J and D.
02. Lot ‘D’ – Extent: 0.1375 HectareNorth: Road; East: Lots. C, H and J; South: Lot J; West: Lots Hand E.
03. Lot ‘E’ – Extent: 0.1264 HectareNorth: Road; East: Lots D and J; South: Lots H and J; West: LotF and Lot No. 4 of F.V.P. 240 A.

06. Lot ‘J’ – Extent: 0.2022 HectareNorth: Lot D; East: Lots C and H; South: Lot H; West: Lots Hand E.
